description.text: The third HeartGold & SoulSilver set, released on 18 August 2010 with 91 cards: 90 and a secret Alph Lithograph. Its LEGEND pairs are Kyogre & Groudon and Rayquaza & Deoxys, and its six Pokémon Prime are Raichu, Houndoom, Espeon, Umbreon, Scizor and Slowking, with nearly all of Eevee's evolutions in the set. Its theme decks, Daybreak around Espeon and Nightfall around Umbreon, were the first with a booster pack, a deck box and a window showing the first card. Its cards came from Revived Legends, Japanese decks and promos.
